projects.title: Next Hire
projects.subtitle: Resume Analyzer & AI Interview Platform
projects.description: Recruitment platform that analyzes resumes, matches them to jobs, generates interview questions and creates resume PDFs.
highlights: Built REST APIs in DRF with JWT authentication and role-based access for recruiters
Compared resume and job description embeddings to tailor interview questions to each candidate
Utilized LangChain with the Gemini API for deep resume analysis and dynamic interview question generation
Stored questions, applicant data, and evaluations in PostgreSQL

projects.title: CodeLens
projects.subtitle: Chat with a GitHub Repo, Answers Cited to Lines
projects.description: RAG code assistant that answers questions about a GitHub repo and cites each answer as exact file and line ranges.
highlights: Implemented hybrid retrieval in Qdrant combining Gemini dense embeddings and BM25 sparse vectors over line-mapped code chunks
Designed a verification prompt chain: query rewrite, retrieval, cited answer, and AST/code validation ensuring all citations exist in retrieved chunks
Engineered guarded ingestion pipeline with GitHub repo size checking, single-ingest locks, and least-recently-queried (LRU) pruning
Deployed frontend on Vercel and backend microservices on Render backed by serverless Neon Postgres

projects.title: VartaRaksha
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Voice Deepfake Detection
projects.description: A Python SDK for real-time AI voice detection, speech context analysis, speaker recognition, and risk pattern detection.
highlights: Engineered real-time acoustic pipeline to classify synthetic/deepfake voices against authentic human speech
Analyzes conversational audio stream for suspicious scam indicators like urgent requests and OTP extortion
Performs biometric speaker recognition via voice similarity matching
Published as a reusable open-source Python SDK package on PyPI
